meta.status: Draft crop list: the D24 candidates in docs/decision-log.md. D24 (final list), D26 (Lanao del Norte planting calendars) and D28 (local check) are still open, so the team confirms or trims this list with a local technician. A value with no source is null and listed in that crop's 'unverified'.
meta.history: 0.1.0 drafted 2026-11-14 on the app-mvp branch (app/public/data/crops.json). 0.2.0 moved here for #11 with every value unchanged; the only addition is a source entry for n_fixing on crops outside the legume family, labelled as a team rule (see method). 2026-11-14: added forage_residue (crop residue commonly fed to livestock, yes/no) per crop from Feedipedia datasheets, each quoted in sources; null where no source was read.
meta.method: Every number was read in this session from the source named in that crop's 'sources' list. Values that could not be checked are null and listed in 'unverified'. stages_days, kc, root_depth_m and p_depletion come from FAO-56 Tables 11, 12 and 22 as printed; stages_days are FAO example rows (none is for the Philippines), so the engine should rescale them to season_days as FAO-56 advises. Kc values are for FAO's standard sub-humid climate (RHmin about 45%, wind about 2 m/s) and should be adjusted for humid Philippine conditions with FAO-56 Eq. 62 and 65. temp_c = FAO Ecocrop TMIN, TOPMN, TOPMX, TMAX. Where a single number was needed from a cited range (season_days), the rounded midpoint was used and this is said in the source text. Waterlogging tolerance uses the crop guide's own words where one exists; otherwise Ecocrop drainage: optimal drainage includes 'poorly drained' = high, range includes it = medium, neither = low (a team-chosen mapping). Drought tolerance uses the crop guide's words, or the FAO-56 Table 24 yield response factor Ky (Ky above 1 = low; below 1 = medium unless a source calls the crop drought tolerant). Yields are PSA OpenSTAT production divided by area for 2022-2024 (sums), Lanao del Norte unless noted. Calendars are national unless noted (no Lanao del Norte calendar was found). labor, market and most cover_value fields are left null for the team to fill from local sources. n_fixing on a crop outside the legume family (Fabaceae) is false by a team rule (an assumption, no source cited): only legumes are taken as nitrogen-fixing, and each crop's family is cited from Ecocrop. The team should confirm this rule or replace it with a citation.

rice_extra_detail.how_rice_extra_mm_was_derived: 6 mm/day average percolation and seepage x 30 days = 180 mm/month while ponded. Add 200 mm in the month before transplanting (soil saturation for puddling) and 100 mm in the transplanting month (water layer). Use 4 mm/day for clayey and 8 mm/day for sandy soil feel.
rice_extra_detail.citation: Brouwer, C., Heibloem, M. 1986. FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 3, Section 4.4 Irrigation water need of rice: SAT = 200 mm, PERC 4-8 mm/day (heavy clay 4, sandy 8, average 6), WL = 100 mm

taw_mm_per_m.citation: FAO-56 Table 19, typical soil water characteristics: (thetaFC - thetaWP) in m3/m3, multiplied by 1000 to give mm of water per m of root depth. TAW = 1000 (thetaFC - thetaWP) Zr (FAO-56 Eq. 82)
